author: shimashimarin
body:
Sherpa version 3 was released last year (see the [Sherpa release notes](https://gitlab.com/sherpa-team/sherpa/-/releases)). This PR adds Sherpa3, pinned to the latest version `v3.0.5`, and supersedes #10572.

As in #10572, this PR:

Switches the build to CMake
Adds libzip as a new Sherpa3 dependency
Adds the OpenLoops include folder, needed to compile Sherpa3

Additionally, this PR patches Sherpa's `CMakeLists.txt` so the Sherpa executable and its libraries are named with the version suffix "3". As a result, both Sherpa 2 and Sherpa 3 will be available in CMSSW, as `sherpa` and `sherpa3` respectively.
title: Add Sherpa3
